intro.title: Build typed mock data builders
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build typed mock data builders in TypeScript. These are functions that help you create realistic, customizable test data for your applications while ensuring type safety. You'll learn how to use TypeScript interfaces and optional parameters to define flexible builder patterns. By the end, you'll have a reusable builder that generates consistent mock objects for testing or development.
intro.usecase: Typed mock data builders are essential for testing complex UI components in real applications. Developers use them to generate consistent test data for dashboards displaying user analytics, e-commerce product listings with filters, or admin panels showing data tables. This pattern ensures type safety when mocking API responses during development, preventing bugs in components like data visualizations, search results, or form submissions. By creating reusable builders, teams can efficiently test edge cases across their application's UI without manual data entry.
